text_block_list.text:
With Nishino Flower's Twinkle Series debut 
on the horizon, serious training was 
finally about to begin!
choice_data_list:
(Time to whip up a training menu right 
away!)

(Let's put together a training menu right 
away!)

text_block_list.text:
She made an inexperienced person like me 
her Trainer. Though I still lack 
experience and knowledge, now that her 
future has been entrusted to me, there is 
only one thing to do.

To serve wholeheartedly. To make up for 
any shortcomings through hard work. Just 
as I was refocusing my resolve—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Thank you for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, I'll officially be under 
your care, so I came to greet you properly 
once again.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm Nishino Flower. I'll do my very best 
from here on out. It's a pleasure to work 
with you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And training is in the afternoon, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If you haven't eaten yet, I was 
wondering... if you'd like to have some." 
his

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Here, it's your bento!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I made this for you, Trainer... I'd be so 
happy if you'd accept it!

The boxed lunch Nishino Flower made for me 
was beautifully packed with 
delicious-looking dishes, including rolled 
omelet, rice balls, simmered food, and 
bean salad.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: How... does that sound...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yay...♪
choice_data_list:
This simmered dish has soaked up the broth 
really well.

This simmered dish has soaked up the broth 
really well.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Simmered butterbur and fried tofu! I made 
it yesterday, so the flavor has soaked in 
nicely ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Oh right, if you have any seasoning 
preferences, please don't hesitate to tell 
me. I'll keep it in mind next time I 
cook!"
choice_data_list: You're gonna make it for me again?
Will you make it for me again?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, Trainer! I really love 
cooking. And above all...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
What makes me happiest is seeing the 
smiles on the faces of the people eating 
my food.

After that, Nishino Flower joined us for 
lunch, and we went straight into training 
right afterward.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ――Hyah...!

Nishino Flower tore through the course. 
Despite her small stature, the sight of 
her running with all her might showed her 
immense baseline ability. Above all else—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...
choice_data_list: That was such a great run!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Really? Thank you very much!
choice_data_list:
Her "grade-skipping" skill is the real 
deal.

Her "grade-skipping" skill is definitely 
the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
T-That's not true at all...! I still have 
so, so far to go!

Nishino Flower was allowed to skip grades 
and enroll in Tracen Academy. This fact 
was, in truth, an "incredible feat."

However, skipping a grade does bring its 
own "concerns." Namely—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower-san, Trainer-san. Pardon 
the interruption during your training.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Tazuna-san? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Do you have some time after training? The 
school nurse said she needs to talk to you 
about Nishino Flower's "body."

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
—Nishino Flower skipped a few grades to 
enroll here at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
This was decided not only because she is 
exceptionally talented, but also because 
it has been determined that her 'blooming 
phase' has begun.

The Awakening. It can be called a growth 
spurt for Umamusume, and those who enter 
it experience an extraordinary leap in 
their athletic capabilities.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
In other words, Nishino Flower is now 
fully capable of holding her own in races. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Compared to the other girls, my body isn't 
fully developed yet... is it?

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. It was explained to Nishino 
Flower-san and her parents before 
enrollment, wasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. She is a girl who will grow so 
much bigger "from here on out."

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
So, please proceed by consulting with her 
body every step of the way. Allow me to 
say it once more: I'm counting on you.

Technically, she's at an age where she'd 
still be in elementary school. Naturally, 
her physique falls short compared to girls 
debuting around the same time.

Going forward, there may be times when 
that handicap hurts her greatly. But for 
now—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the running itself is totally 
fine... right? I'll train as hard as I can 
and make up for whatever I'm lacking!”

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's a great attitude. I'm sure 
you'll become a wonderful Umamusume. Do 
your best.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I'll do my very best...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There might be a lot of hardships ahead. 
Even so, I'll do my very best to overcome 
them!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Then I'll work even harder and harder!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, so... about after this. I'm still full 
of energy. Shall we do some extra 
training?
choice_data_list:
It's only day one, let's call it a day and 
get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Will you be taking a break as 
well, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Studying?

While it poses no hindrance to her debut, 
there is no doubt she carries a unique set 
of circumstances.

If that is the case, there is much to 
learn each day to prepare for any 
unforeseen circumstances. Because...
choice_data_list: Because I still have so much to learn.
I still have a long way to go, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes! See you tomorrow...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer seemed a little lacking in 
confidence...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Even though I'm so small and unreliable, 
you told me it was okay... and even became 
my Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(My kind Trainer. I want to give you 
courage... and confidence.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But what should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Flower-chan, is something troubling 
you~?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
! Sorry, I was just lost in thought for a 
second...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Grass Wonder-san. A gentle and kind 
person who serves alongside me on the 
Beautification Committee.)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to apologize~ If there's 
anything about the job you don't 
understand, feel free to ask me anything.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you very much! I'll go water 
the flower bed right away.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Nn... Huh? This flowerbed is empty. Even 
though moss phlox was planted here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it looks like there are no plans to 
plant anything new over there for now~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If you have any ideas on how to utilize 
it, please feel free to consult with me~.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(A new flowerbed, huh. It'd be so pretty 
if lots of different flowers were blooming 
here.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu. Seeing flowers doing their best to 
bloom always gives me so much courage, 
doesn't it?)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: If I try my very hardest...――
